summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The 18 new parametrized cases and the existing test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv (39 passed). Nothing committed. Not verified: mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. The type-ignore on the `with pytest.raises(...)` line is the spec's requirement but may be reported as unused by mypy; running mypy would settle it.
